messages:
liam (incident-mgr): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear customer-facing comms + an owner for each remediation. Who can lead status page language and the external summary?
chris (product): I can draft the status page blurb. Will share a concise version + a slightly-more-detailed incident summary for customers.
asha (customer-success): please make two variants: 1) short statuspage line, 2) emailed summary for impacted customers. Need timeline for when we can publish.
maria (eng-sre): FYI the root cause traces into the autoscaler edge-case we flagged last quarter — looks like a recurrence. We should call out recurrence and mitigation plan in the RCA, but be careful with legal phrasing.
sofia (support): Can we get the customer-facing summary by EOD tomorrow? customers are asking for specifics beyond "investigating". Also need a clear statement on whether data was affected.
chris (product): Draft 1 incoming in ~3 hours. Quick Q: do we want the status page line to mention "ongoing" vs "resolved" right away?
liam (incident-mgr): Put 'resolved — networking config caused autoscaler collision, mitigation rolled out' if verified. If not verified, put 'investigating'. For now assume we'll confirm before publishing.
chris (product): Draft status page copy: ```Resolved: We experienced degraded API availability for ~22 minutes due to a networking configuration that caused autoscaler overlap between pools. A mitigation was applied and normal service has resumed. We are performing a full RCA and will share findings and follow-up actions within 72 hours.```
asha (customer-success): That reads good. For the emailed summary can we add the impact window and list of affected endpoints? customers want concrete indicators.
maria (eng-sre): Impact window: 13:04–13:26 UTC. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (hosted), embeddings endpoints for batch jobs. No customer data was accessed or modified.
sofia (support): pls include a short FAQ line: "Will this happen again?" -> "We have mitigations and an owner assigned; see remediation plan."
liam (incident-mgr): Action items (quick list):
- AI-1: update status page copy + publish after confirm (owner: chris) — due 2026-03-30T18:00Z
- AI-2: send targeted email to impacted customers with timeline and endpoints (owner: asha) — due 2026-03-31T12:00Z
- AI-3: assign dedicated remediation owner & timeline for autoscaler config fix (owner: maria) — due 2026-04-07T23:59Z
- AI-4: add recurring incident check to weekly reliability review (owner: liam) — due 2026-03-27T09:00Z
- AI-5: decide RCA sharing policy for external customers (owner: chris + legal) — due 2026-04-02T17:00Z
chris (product): I'll publish the status page after Maria confirms final wording and the impact window. I'll also coordinate with Legal on the RCA sharing wording (AI-5).
maria (eng-sre): Confirmed wording ok. I'll open a remediation ticket and link the rollout plan here. Quick note: recommend a staged deploy and a canary to prevent overlap, ETA for PR by 2026-04-03.
liam (incident-mgr): On RCA sharing policy: proposal = standard external summary + redacted technical details; full RCA available under NDA / enterprise channel. This prevents exposing internal infra specifics while offering transparency. Thoughts? @chris @legal?
chris (product): Agree with the proposal. For enterprise customers who sign an NDA we can provide detailed logs and config diffs. For public status page stick to summary + follow-ups.
asha (customer-success): That policy works. We should add an explicit line in the email offering an enterprise follow-up call for large customers.
sofia (support): Adding to AI tracker: add a toggle in the incident template that sets RCA visibility level (public / limited / enterprise). Saves people asking later.
liam (incident-mgr): ops-bot posted deploy logs during the incident:
```ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-25T13:03:58Z -> failed autoscaler job started on pool-b
ops-bot: mitigation applied 2026-03-25T13:25:12Z -> scaled down overlapping controllers
```
maria (eng-sre): I'll attach the logs to the remediation ticket. Also creating a short test to catch autoscaler collisions in our staging cluster.
chris (product): Timeline recap: status page published once Maria confirms (today if possible), customer email + FAQ tomorrow, remediation PR in ~10 days, RCA sharing policy decided next week.
liam (incident-mgr): Thanks everyone. I'll own the AI tracker and post weekly progress notes in #incidents until closed. Ping me if you need to update owners/dates. :thumbsup:
sofia (support): ack. I'll update the customer-facing FAQ snippet and drop it here when ready.
asha (customer-success): Thanks — will draft the email and loop in account owners for customers impacted.
maria (eng-sre): marking AI-3 ticket created: #IN-4321. Will update with PR link.
liam (incident-mgr): last note — recurring pattern: please add a label "recurring-autoscaler" to the ticket so we can run cross-incident analysis. I'll add to the weekly reliability agenda.
chris (product): copied. closing thread for now, reopening if any blocker. :white_check_mark:
